persona: SaaS account manager moving into customer success
resumeText:
Priya Menon | Kochi | priya.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Account Manager, Backwaters HR Cloud, Kochi (2021 - present)
- Managed renewals for 60 mid-market accounts and cut churn from 9% to 5% in a year.
- Ran quarterly business reviews with HR heads to show usage and return on investment.
- Logged every call and renewal date in HubSpot for the whole portfolio.
- Built Excel trackers of logins and feature usage for each account.
- Explained new payroll features to customers on monthly webinars in English and Malayalam.

Inside Sales Executive, Backwaters HR Cloud, Kochi (2018 - 2021)
- Booked product demos for small businesses across Kerala.

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Rajagiri College of Social Sciences, 2018
